title: Admissible finite scheme quotient with invariant structure sheaf
statement: Let $G$ be a finite group acting by scheme automorphisms on a scheme $C$ [def-pc-scheme], and let $\pi:C\to X$ be a scheme morphism. Say that $\pi$ is an admissible finite scheme quotient for this action if every $G$-orbit in $C$ lies in an affine open, $\pi$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and $G$-invariant, its underlying map is a topological quotient map, its fibres on underlying points are exactly the $G$-orbits, and for every open $U\subseteq X$ the canonical map $\mathcal O_X(U)\to\mathcal O_C(\pi^{-1}U)$ is injective with image exactly the $G$-invariant sections. Here an invariant section means that its pullback by each action automorphism equals itself; equivalently, these two sections have equal restrictions on every open contained in both of their domains. Thus $X$ is the orbit-space quotient with structure sheaf $(\pi_*\mathcal O_C)^G$.
